prompts: The game went down in June and we owe the team an incident report. The logs and their notes are in {WS}/logs. When did it start and end, how long was it, did we keep our monthly availability target, and why did it happen? Record it in {WS}/result.json: start, end, minutes_down, availability_june_pct, slo_999_ok, root_cause.
answers:
The logs confirm the sequence: 03:17:42 first save error (No space left on device) → repeated failed watchdog restarts (exit 137) → 03:52:10 backup rotation freed 38.2 GB → 03:53:31 "server ready, accepting players". All verified against the raw log lines in gameserver-2026-06-02.log.

**What I found**

- **Start:** 2026-06-02 03:17:42 — first `ERROR SaveGame failed: ... No space left on device` (README defines down as "from the first save error").
- **End:** 2026-06-02 03:53:31 — `INFO server ready, accepting players`.
- **Duration:** 35.82 minutes (2149 s).
- **June availability:** 99.9171% — 1 − 2149/(30·24·3600); target 99.9% → **met** (`slo_999_ok: true`).
- **Root cause:** /data disk filled up (WARN at 03:10: disk 97%, free 3.1 GB) so autosaves failed with ENOSPC; the watchdog then killed the unresponsive server (code 137) and every restart kept failing until the 03:52:10 backup rotation freed 38.2 GB, after which the server came up at 03:53:31.

**Assumptions (stated, since the brief leaves them open)**
- "June" = the full 30-day month (README confirms), and the single incident is what the README says is the only one — the June 1 09:12 RCON auth failure was a separate, non-downtime event and was excluded per the "first save error" definition.
- `start`/`end` recorded in the logs' local timestamp format, ISO-free.
- minutes_down and availability are rounded to 2 / 4 decimals from exact values (35.8167 min; 99.91709%).

Recorded in `./result.json` with keys `start`, `end`, `minutes_down`, `availability_june_pct`, `slo_999_ok`, `root_cause`. No browser tabs, windows or apps were opened, so nothing to close.

**How I know it's right:** start/end are quoted verbatim from log lines 251 and 294 of gameserver-2026-06-02.log; I grepped all three logs for ERROR/WARN/FATAL/save/server-ready lines and the save-error→server-ready window contains exactly one contiguous incident; duration and availability were computed by script from those two timestamps, not eyeballed.
